about: Who writes what. data_writer: 'pc' (the PC's tasks write data/nba/; the GitHub ticks write data/nba_cloud/ for the side-by-side check) or 'cloud' (the GitHub ticks write data/nba/ and the PC's tasks stand down). odds_pretip: who starts the pre-tip betting-line read, 'pc' (the live watcher) or 'tick'.
